title: Housing - Living on Campus - PNW
text:
Housing
Housing
College is a time of growth, inside and outside of the classroom. In PNW housing, you can fully immerse yourself in the experience with comfortable, convenient housing while learning and making lifelong friends!
Welcome to Your New Home on Campus
Get ready for an exciting college experience on our vibrant Hammond campus, perfect for you and your new best friends!
We offer traditional and suite-style rooms in our three residence halls.
MOVE-IN DATES
Furnished rooms:
Comfortable living with all the essentials for just you or shared with a roommate.
Laundry facilities:
Easy access to laundry right where you need it.
24-hour service desks and staff on call:
Assistance is always available, day or night, for any need or emergency.
Versatile study spaces:
Use study rooms for focused work and group sessions.
Outdoor patios:
Relax with friends or enjoy yard games
WiFi and printers throughout the complex:
Stay connected and print your work wherever you are.
Exciting events year-round:
From movie nights and game nights to holiday celebrations, PNW residence halls bring the fun to you!
Walkable campus:
Less than a mile from every campus building.
Right by the fitness center:
Stay active and energized.
Purdue University Northwest has expanded housing options by building a third residence hall on Hammond Campus. Newly open in Fall 2026, Calumet Hall provides 150 beds of single- and double-occupancy rooms, plus a common kitchen, laundry facilities, student study areas and a student lounge.
Home sweet home! Peregrine and Griffin Halls are the homes of PNW's suite-style rooms.
Calumet Hall, PNW's newest dorm, provides 150 beds of single- and double-occupancy rooms, plus a common kitchen, laundry facilities, student study areas and a student lounge.
The suites in Griffin and Peregrine Halls have spacious common areas are perfect for hanging out with friends, studying for class and relaxing.
Calumet Hall features a common kitchen, laundry faculties, student study areas and a student lounge.
Show off your cooking skills in our fully furnished kitchens! Griffin and Peregrine Halls offer in-suite kitchens, while Calumet Hall has a shared kitchen on the first floor.
University Village offers plenty of space to relax, play and connect beyond your room.
Calumet Hall is bringing a bold and modern living experience to campus—get ready to connect with the community and enjoy the new vibrant spaces built just for you!
Our outdoor tables are the perfect spot to study while soaking up some sunshine.
Get ready to live bright and smart! Purdue University Northwest is thrilled to welcome students into Calumet Hall in Fall 2026—featuring modern and efficient living spaces designed for you to succeed!
University Village isn't just a place to live, it's a place to grow, learn and make lifelong connections!
Griffin and Peregrine Halls offer a variety of floor plans. The four-bedroom floor plan (pictured above) features two bathrooms and a central living and kitchen space.
Room Types and Rates
Purdue University Northwest offers a variety of residential living options, with six distinct room types for students to choose from. Whether you’re looking for a cozier space or a shared environment with friends, there’s something to fit every preference and lifestyle. Find the perfect room to make your college experience comfortable and personalized!
Explore detailed room types and costs
The prices listed below reflect the full academic year costs for 2026-27. Prices may change.
